query: We thus asked 36 participants (different from those that took part in the fMRI study) to spontaneously write down all the actions that came to their mind within 10 min that they or other people are likely to do or observe.
matched_segment: We thus asked 36 participants (different from those that took part in the fMRI study) to spontaneously write down all the actions that came to their mind within 10 min that they or other people are likely to do or observe.

query: Actions were selected if they were mentioned by at least 20% of the participants.
matched_segment: Actions were selected if they were mentioned by at least 20% of the participants.

query: In total, we identified 37 actions (see Supplementary file 3).
matched_segment: In total, we identified 37 actions (see Supplementary file 3).

query: To maximize perceptual variability within each action, and thus to minimize low-level feature differences between actions, we varied the actors (2), the scene (2) and perspectives (3), for a total of 12 exemplars per action.
matched_segment: To maximize perceptual variability within each action, and thus to minimize low-level feature differences between actions, we varied the actors (2), the scene (2) and perspectives (3), for a total of 12 exemplars per action.

query: Exemplars for the action 'swimming' were collected from the Internet because of the difficulties in taking photos in a public swimming pool.
matched_segment: Exemplars for the action 'swimming' were collected from the Internet because of the difficulties in taking photos in a public swimming pool.

query: Therefore, the final number of actions chosen for the main experiment was 28 (see Supplementary file 3).
matched_segment: Therefore, the final number of actions chosen for the main experiment was 28 (see Supplementary file 3).

query: Note that we decided to use static images instead of videos of actions for two reasons. First of all, we wished to avoid systematic differences between conditions based on the kinematic profiles of videos of actions. Second, we aimed to use stimuli that are suitable both for the fMRI experiment and for the inverse MDS experiment. We considered static stimuli more suitable for the latter, given that the participant had to judge the similarity of a large set of actions simultaneously.
matched_segment: Note that we decided to use static images instead of videos of actions for two reasons. First of all, we wished to avoid systematic differences between conditions based on the kinematic profiles of videos of actions. Second, we aimed to use stimuli that are suitable both for the fMRI experiment and for the inverse MDS experiment. We considered static stimuli more suitable for the latter, given that the participant had to judge the similarity of a large set of actions simultaneously.

query: The fMRI experiment consisted of twelve functional runs and one anatomical sequence halfway through the experiment.
matched_segment: The fMRI experiment consisted of twelve functional runs and one anatomical sequence halfway through the experiment.

query: Each functional run started and ended with 15 s of fixation.
matched_segment: Each functional run started and ended with 15 s of fixation.

query: Each functional run consisted of 56 experimental trials (28 exemplars of the action categories performed by each of the two actors) and 18 null events (to enhance design efficiency) presented in a pseudorandomized order (preventing that the same action was shown in two consecutive trials, except during catch trials, see next paragraph).
matched_segment: Each functional run consisted of 56 experimental trials (28 exemplars of the action categories performed by each of the two actors) and 18 null events (to enhance design efficiency) presented in a pseudorandomized order (preventing that the same action was shown in two consecutive trials, except during catch trials, see next paragraph).

query: A trial consisted of the presentation of an action image for 1 s followed by 3 s of fixation.
matched_segment: A trial consisted of the presentation of an action image for 1 s followed by 3 s of fixation.

query: A null event consisted of the presentation of a fixation cross for 4 s.
matched_segment: A null event consisted of the presentation of a fixation cross for 4 s.

query: In this way, each participant saw each exemplar twice during the entire experiment (and thus each action was presented 24 times).
matched_segment: In this way, each participant saw each exemplar twice during the entire experiment (and thus each action was presented 24 times).

query: To ensure that participants paid attention to the stimuli, we included seven (out of 63; 4.41%) catch trials in each run which consisted in the presentation of an image depicting the same action (but not the same exemplar) as the action presented in trial N-1 (e.g. eating an apple, actor A, scene A, followed by eating a sandwich, actor B, scene B).
matched_segment: To ensure that participants paid attention to the stimuli, we included seven (out of 63; 4.41%) catch trials in each run which consisted in the presentation of an image depicting the same action (but not the same exemplar) as the action presented in trial N-1 (e.g. eating an apple, actor A, scene A, followed by eating a sandwich, actor B, scene B).

query: Participants were instructed to press a button with their right index finger whenever they detected an action repetition.
matched_segment: Participants were instructed to press a button with their right index finger whenever they detected an action repetition.

query: Catch trials were discarded from multivariate data analysis.
matched_segment: Catch trials were discarded from multivariate data analysis.

query: Functional and structural data were acquired using a Siemens TIM Trio 3T MRI scanner.
matched_segment: Functional and structural data were acquired using a Siemens TIM Trio 3T MRI scanner.

query: For the acquisition of the functional images, we used a T2*-weighted gradient EPI sequence. The repetition time (TR) was 2.5 s, the echo time (TE) was 30 milliseconds, the flip angle was 85°, the field of view was 192 × 192 mm, the matrix size was 64 × 64, and the voxel resolution was 3 × 3 × 3 mm.
matched_segment: For the acquisition of the functional images, we used a T2*-weighted gradient EPI sequence. The repetition time (TR) was 2.5 s, the echo time (TE) was 30 milliseconds, the flip angle was 85°, the field of view was 192 × 192 mm, the matrix size was 64 × 64, and the voxel resolution was 3 × 3 × 3 mm.

query: A total of 37 slices were acquired in ascending interleaved order.
matched_segment: A total of 37 slices were acquired in ascending interleaved order.

query: Each functional run lasted 5 min and 55 s and consisted of 142 volumes.
matched_segment: Each functional run lasted 5 min and 55 s and consisted of 142 volumes.

query: For the structural data, we used a T1*-weighted MPRAGE sequence (image size 256 × 256 × 176 voxels, voxel size 1 × 1 × 1 mm, TR 1.9 s, TE 3.03, flip angle 11), lasting 5 min and 35 s.
matched_segment: For the structural data, we used a T1*-weighted MPRAGE sequence (image size 256 × 256 × 176 voxels, voxel size 1 × 1 × 1 mm, TR 1.9 s, TE 3.03, flip angle 11), lasting 5 min and 35 s.

query: Anatomical data were segmented using FreeSurfer (Fischl et al., 1999).
matched_segment: Anatomical data were segmented using FreeSurfer (Fischl et al., 1999).

query: Preprocessing of the functional data was carried out using SPM12 (http://www.fil.ion.ucl.ac.uk/spm/software/spm12/).
matched_segment: Preprocessing of the functional data was carried out using SPM12 (http://www.fil.ion.ucl.ac.uk/spm/software/spm12/).

query: The slices of each functional volume were slice time corrected and then spatially realigned to correct for head movements.
matched_segment: The slices of each functional volume were slice time corrected and then spatially realigned to correct for head movements.

query: Functional volumes were then coregistered to the individual anatomical image.
matched_segment: Functional volumes were then coregistered to the individual anatomical image.

query: Analyses were conducted in individual volume space, but using the inner and outer surfaces obtained with FreeSurfer as a constraint to select the voxels included in each searchlight as implemented in CoSMoMVPA (Oosterhof et al., 2011; Oosterhof et al., 2016).
matched_segment: Analyses were conducted in individual volume space, but using the inner and outer surfaces obtained with FreeSurfer as a constraint to select the voxels included in each searchlight as implemented in CoSMoMVPA (Oosterhof et al., 2011; Oosterhof et al., 2016).

query: The resulting maps were resampled to the surface level on the Human Connectome Project common space FS_LR 32 k (Glasser et al., 2013) using FreeSurfer and workbench connectome (Marcus et al., 2011).
matched_segment: The resulting maps were resampled to the surface level on the Human Connectome Project common space FS_LR 32 k (Glasser et al., 2013) using FreeSurfer and workbench connectome (Marcus et al., 2011).

query: Multivariate analyses were conducted using unsmoothed data.
matched_segment: Multivariate analyses were conducted using unsmoothed data.

query: Following the fMRI experiment, either on the same or the next day, participants took part in an additional behavioral experiment in which they carried out an inverse MDS task using similar procedures as described above (see Materials and methods section and Figure 1B).
matched_segment: Following the fMRI experiment, either on the same or the next day, participants took part in an additional behavioral experiment in which they carried out an inverse MDS task using similar procedures as described above (see Materials and methods section and Figure 1B).

query: In separate blocks of the experiment, participants were asked to arrange the actions according to their perceived similarity in terms of (a) meaning (referred to as 'semantics' in the remainder of the text), (b) the body part(s) involved, (c) scene, (d) movement kinematics, (e) the object involved.
matched_segment: In separate blocks of the experiment, participants were asked to arrange the actions according to their perceived similarity in terms of (a) meaning (referred to as 'semantics' in the remainder of the text), (b) the body part(s) involved, (c) scene, (d) movement kinematics, (e) the object involved.

query: The order of blocks was counterbalanced across participants.
matched_segment: The order of blocks was counterbalanced across participants.

query: To further characterize the structure that emerged from the inverse MDS, we adopted principal component analysis (PCA) as implemented in the R package cluster to individuate the principal components along which the actions were organized.
matched_segment: To further characterize the structure that emerged from the inverse MDS, we adopted principal component analysis (PCA) as implemented in the R package cluster to individuate the principal components along which the actions were organized.

query: To characterize the observed clusters, we furthermore used a model-based approach using the K-means (Hartigan and Wang, 1979) clustering method.
matched_segment: To characterize the observed clusters, we furthermore used a model-based approach using the K-means (Hartigan and Wang, 1979) clustering method.

query: To this aim, we used the Silhouette method (Rousseeuw, 1987) as implemented in the R package factoextra to estimate the optimal number of clusters.
matched_segment: To this aim, we used the Silhouette method (Rousseeuw, 1987) as implemented in the R package factoextra to estimate the optimal number of clusters.

query: Individual dissimilarity matrices were used as a model for the multiple regression-based representational similarity analysis of fMRI data (see section Representational Similarity Analysis).
matched_segment: Individual dissimilarity matrices were used as a model for the multiple regression-based representational similarity analysis of fMRI data (see section Representational Similarity Analysis).

query: We found significant (all p-values were smaller than p<0.0001 and survived false discovery rate correction) inter-observer correlations, that is the individual RDMs significantly correlated with the average RDMs of the remaining participants (mean leave-one-subject-out correlation coefficients [min – max individual correlation coefficients]; semantic model: 0.61 [0.46–0.78], body model: 0.57 [0.31–0.70]; scene model: 0.63 [0.40–0.78]; movement model: 0.47 [0.26–0.67]; object model: 0.51 [0.22–0.71].
matched_segment: We found significant (all p-values were smaller than p<0.0001 and survived false discovery rate correction) inter-observer correlations, that is the individual RDMs significantly correlated with the average RDMs of the remaining participants (mean leave-one-subject-out correlation coefficients [min – max individual correlation coefficients]; semantic model: 0.61 [0.46–0.78], body model: 0.57 [0.31–0.70]; scene model: 0.63 [0.40–0.78]; movement model: 0.47 [0.26–0.67]; object model: 0.51 [0.22–0.71].

query: To construct RDMs for the sociality and the transitivity models (Wurm et al., 2017), we conducted an online experiment using Qualtrics and Amazon Mechanical Turn in which we asked a separate group of N = 20 participants to judge on a Likert scale (1: not at all; 7: very much) the sociality (i.e. the interaction between the actors involved) and transitivity (i.e. the use of an object) of each action.
matched_segment: To construct RDMs for the sociality and the transitivity models (Wurm et al., 2017), we conducted an online experiment using Qualtrics and Amazon Mechanical Turn in which we asked a separate group of N = 20 participants to judge on a Likert scale (1: not at all; 7: very much) the sociality (i.e. the interaction between the actors involved) and transitivity (i.e. the use of an object) of each action.

query: To construct the RDM for the distance model, we asked another group of N = 20 participants to judge the distance (1: within reaching distance; 2: not within reaching distance, but <= 3 meters, 3:>3 meters) from the observer at which each action takes place.
matched_segment: To construct the RDM for the distance model, we asked another group of N = 20 participants to judge the distance (1: within reaching distance; 2: not within reaching distance, but <= 3 meters, 3:>3 meters) from the observer at which each action takes place.

query: The model controlling for the number of people depicted in the action was constructed by coding one person involved as 0 and two people involved as 1.
matched_segment: The model controlling for the number of people depicted in the action was constructed by coding one person involved as 0 and two people involved as 1.

query: The HMAX-C1 model (Serre et al., 2007) was derived similarly to Connolly et al. (2012) in the following way: we computed the C1 representation of each stimulus image (i.e. each exemplar of an action) and then averaged across the exemplar response vectors to obtain one C1 vector for each action.
matched_segment: The HMAX-C1 model (Serre et al., 2007) was derived similarly to Connolly et al. (2012) in the following way: we computed the C1 representation of each stimulus image (i.e. each exemplar of an action) and then averaged across the exemplar response vectors to obtain one C1 vector for each action.

query: As can be seen, not surprisingly, there are modest correlations between the different models (in particular when averaged across participants).
matched_segment: As can be seen, not surprisingly, there are modest correlations between the different models (in particular when averaged across participants).

query: However, as shown in the Materials and methods section on multiple regression RSA, the Variance Inflation Factor indicated a low risk of collinearity and thus justified the use of these models for multiple regression RSA.
matched_segment: However, as shown in the Materials and methods section on multiple regression RSA, the Variance Inflation Factor indicated a low risk of collinearity and thus justified the use of these models for multiple regression RSA.

query: Each searchlight consisted of 100 features (one central vertex + 99 neighbors) and was approximately 12 mm in radius.
matched_segment: Each searchlight consisted of 100 features (one central vertex + 99 neighbors) and was approximately 12 mm in radius.

query: All multivariate analyses were carried out using custom written Matlab functions (available at: osf.io/cvrb2 ; Tucciarelli, 2019) and CoSMoMVPA (Oosterhof et al., 2016).
matched_segment: All multivariate analyses were carried out using custom written Matlab functions (available at: osf.io/cvrb2 ; Tucciarelli, 2019) and CoSMoMVPA (Oosterhof et al., 2016).

query: For the multivariate analysis, the design matrix consisted of 142 volumes X 28 predictors of interest (resulting from the 28 actions) plus nuisance predictors consisting of the catch trials, the parameters resulting from motion correction, and a constant term.
matched_segment: For the multivariate analysis, the design matrix consisted of 142 volumes X 28 predictors of interest (resulting from the 28 actions) plus nuisance predictors consisting of the catch trials, the parameters resulting from motion correction, and a constant term.

query: Thus, for each participant, we obtained 28 beta maps at the volume level.
matched_segment: Thus, for each participant, we obtained 28 beta maps at the volume level.

query: First, to identify clusters in which the neural data reflected the dissimilarity pattern captured by the semantic model, we conducted a standard RSA. For this analysis, the beta maps were averaged across runs.
matched_segment: First, to identify clusters in which the neural data reflected the dissimilarity pattern captured by the semantic model, we conducted a standard RSA. For this analysis, the beta maps were averaged across runs.

query: For each searchlight, we derived the normalized RDM using squared Euclidian distance as distance metric (note that we chose this distance metric, rather than Spearman correlation, for a more straightforward comparison of the results of the standard and multiple regression RSA; see also next paragraph).
matched_segment: For each searchlight, we derived the normalized RDM using squared Euclidian distance as distance metric (note that we chose this distance metric, rather than Spearman correlation, for a more straightforward comparison of the results of the standard and multiple regression RSA; see also next paragraph).

query: The correlation maps of this first-level analysis were then resampled to the common space and Fisher transformed to normalize the distribution across participants to run a second-level analysis.
matched_segment: The correlation maps of this first-level analysis were then resampled to the common space and Fisher transformed to normalize the distribution across participants to run a second-level analysis.

query: Specifically, the correlation maps for the semantic model of all N participants were tested against zero using a one-tailed t-test at each vertex.
matched_segment: Specifically, the correlation maps for the semantic model of all N participants were tested against zero using a one-tailed t-test at each vertex.

query: The resulting t maps were corrected using a cluster-based nonparametric Monte Carlo permutation analysis (5000 iterations; initial threshold p<0.001 ; Stelzer et al., 2013).
matched_segment: The resulting t maps were corrected using a cluster-based nonparametric Monte Carlo permutation analysis (5000 iterations; initial threshold p<0.001 ; Stelzer et al., 2013).

query: To determine clusters in which the neural RDM correlated with a given RDM (with a specific focus on the semantic model) while accounting for the remaining RDMs, we conducted a multiple regression RSA at each searchlight. For this analysis, the beta patterns were first normalized across images and then averaged across runs.
matched_segment: To determine clusters in which the neural RDM correlated with a given RDM (with a specific focus on the semantic model) while accounting for the remaining RDMs, we conducted a multiple regression RSA at each searchlight. For this analysis, the beta patterns were first normalized across images and then averaged across runs.

query: Before computing the neural RDM, the betas of a searchlight were also normalized across features.
matched_segment: Before computing the neural RDM, the betas of a searchlight were also normalized across features.

query: Following the procedure used by Bonner and Epstein (2018), the neural RDM for each searchlight was computed using the squared Euclidean distance.
matched_segment: Following the procedure used by Bonner and Epstein (2018), the neural RDM for each searchlight was computed using the squared Euclidean distance.

query: Using the squared Euclidian distance as distance metric for multiple regression RSA, which models distances from a brain RDM as linear combinations of the distances from a number of predictor RDMs, guarantees that the distance metric sums linearly.
matched_segment: Using the squared Euclidian distance as distance metric for multiple regression RSA, which models distances from a brain RDM as linear combinations of the distances from a number of predictor RDMs, guarantees that the distance metric sums linearly.

query: The VIFs were relatively small (average VIF semantic model: 1.61, body model: 1.37, scene model: 1.63, movement model: 1.35, object model: 1.38, sociality model: 1.54, transitivity model: 1.31, distance model: 1.22, 1 vs 2 People model: 1.37, HMAX-C1 model: 1.06), indicating a low risk of multicollinearity (Mason et al., 2003) and thus justifying the use of multiple regression RSA.
